description: This is a PHP source file defining the tlRestApi class, which implements REST API endpoints for managing test projects, test cases, test plans, test suites, and related entities in the TestLink test management system. It includes methods for creating, updating, retrieving, and executing test cases and plans, as well as authentication and request handling logic.

classes.name: tlRestApi
classes.description: The tlRestApi class encapsulates the RESTful API endpoints for interacting with the TestLink system. It includes methods for authentication, project and test case management, and execution recording. It handles incoming HTTP requests, processes various parameters, interacts with the database and managers, and returns JSON-encoded responses.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the API, sets up routes, database connection, and manager objects, and configures response headers.

methods.name: authenticate
methods.description: Authenticates requests by verifying the provided API key from HTTP headers against the database.

methods.name: whoAmI
methods.description: Returns information about the current API endpoint.

methods.name: getProjects
methods.description: Retrieves accessible test projects for the authenticated user, optionally by project ID or name.

methods.name: getProjectTestPlans
methods.description: Fetches all test plans associated with a specific test project.

methods.name: getProjectTestCases
methods.description: Gets the latest versions of test cases within a given project.

methods.name: createTestProject
methods.description: Creates a new test project using data from the request body.

methods.name: createTestCaseExecution
methods.description: Records a test case execution, validating environment details before writing to the database.

methods.name: checkExecutionEnvironment
methods.description: Validates the environment and preconditions for executing a test case, including project, build, platform, and test case validations.

methods.name: createTestPlan
methods.description: Creates a new test plan based on submitted data.

methods.name: updateTestPlan
methods.description: Updates an existing test plan identified by ID.

methods.name: createTestCase
methods.description: Creates a new test case, performing necessary parent relationship checks.

methods.name: getUserID
methods.description: Retrieves internal user ID from login name (implementation not provided).

methods.name: createTestCaseDefaultManagement
methods.description: Assigns default management fields such as author ID for a test case.

methods.name: checkRelatives
methods.description: Validates that test project and test suite IDs exist and are correctly related.
